description: This file defines the View class within the Goteo project. It manages the rendering of view templates, including setting variables, locating view files, and handling exceptions during rendering.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class for handling view templates rendering, variable management, and file location within the Goteo framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a View object with a filename and optional variables.

methods.name: addViewPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path to the list of view locations.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets variables to be used within the view templates.

methods.name: getMIME
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the view, defaulting to 'text/html'.

methods.name: getViewPath
methods.description: Locates the full path to the view file, throws exception if not found and exception flag is true.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Includes the view file and captures its output, handling exceptions during rendering.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method that creates a new View object and renders it immediately.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Allows the View object to be converted to a string, rendering the view or terminating on exception.
